Name: Older Rasmodia - Portraits and Sprites
Author: caatdaad
Description:
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54850/54850-1793420087-1319754898.png[/img][/center]

This mod aims to give our favorite witch a more vanilla-esque appearance that evokes the same vibe that the vanilla Wizard portraits do. Thanks to the portraits I commissioned from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/DolphinIsNotaFish?gameId=1303]DolphinIsNotAFish[/url], that idea became a reality.



[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54850/54850-1793420046-853231980.png[/img]
[/center]
[center][/center]
[list]
[*]Download the mod.[/*]
[*]Unzip.[/*]
[*]Put it in your mod folder.[/*]
[/list]
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54850/54850-1793420130-1194512906.png[/img]
[/center]
[center][/center]
[list]
[*]A sprite and portrait for each season, the Flower Dance, and Ginger Island.[/*]
[*]A Non-Seasonal toggle if you wish to keep her in her default outfit.[/*]
[*]Compatible with Stardew Valley Expanded, Romanceable Rasmodius, and Romanceable Rasmodius SVE.[/*]
[*]Portraits commissioned from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/DolphinIsNotaFish?gameId=1303]DolphinIsNotAFish[/url], heavily based on Magnus' expression sheet from SVE. The seasonal recolors were done by me.[/*]
[*]Sprites drawn by me, edited from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/Poltergeister]Poltergeister's[/url] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]SCA[/url] Wizard sprites and with a few extra edits to my liking (mainly color matching).[/*]
[*]Hatless variants for every portrait and sprite![/*]
[/list]
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54850/54850-1793420163-1780796483.png[/img]
[/center]
[center][/center]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8265]Romanceable Rasmodia - Female Wizard[/url][/*]
[/list]
